error_message: Unauthorized (401) when user tries to join a faction after Supabase Auth signup
symptom: User signs up via app, sees 'Unauthorized' on faction selection / chat / other RPCs. Reported for maxime.lauza@gmail.com, also affects 6 others including Pierrick Valence.
root_cause: Trigger handle_new_user (mig 074) maintains a hardcoded list of UPDATE statements to migrate FK columns from the old user id (shopify-* or app-*) to the new Supabase Auth UUID. Many tables added since the baseline (notifications, voyage_*, user_crowns, place_court_action, push_subscriptions, note_reactions, etc.) reference public.users(id) but are NOT in the trigger's list. When the trigger reaches the final DELETE FROM public.users WHERE id = v_existing.id, a foreign key violation on an unlisted table (notifications.recipient_id for Maxime) causes the EXCEPTION block to fire, which inserts a stub row with email_address = '__migrated_<uuid>'. The user is then authenticated but his real profile is on the old id, unreachable by his JWT — every RPC that joins on users.id by auth.uid() returns NULL or unauthorized.
fix: Migration 170 redefines handle_new_user and migrate_user_to_auth_id to enumerate FK columns dynamically via information_schema instead of a hardcoded list. Migration 171 cleans up the 7 existing stubs by matching them to their old row via auth.users.email and merging data + redirecting all FKs.

error_message: Users report 'site inaccessible' / 'erreur DNS' on app.runesdechene.com; shared place links and SEO-page CTAs dead
symptom: Intermittent failures reaching the app, Instagram in-app browser won't open it, vague/uncertain errors reported as 'DNS'. A client who had NEVER used carte. also failed on app.
root_cause: Two distinct issues misattributed to DNS. DNS for app. was healthy (resolved 24/24 on Google/Cloudflare, served HTTP 200, ns1/ns2 o2switch consistent, no CAA). (1) The TLS certificate for app.runesdechene.com had expired / failed to auto-renew on Netlify -> SSL handshake failures for fresh clients and strict WebViews (Instagram), commonly misreported as DNS errors. hub.runesdechene.com has the SAME issue: Netlify serves its default *.netlify.app cert -> name mismatch (SEC_E_WRONG_PRINCIPAL). Probable recurrence cause: o2switch AND Netlify both attempting Let's Encrypt issuance for the same FQDN -> rate-limit/validation conflict (user couldn't generate on EITHER). (2) Every share link plus all seo-pages CTAs / canonical / sitemap / JSON-LD still hardcoded the dead legacy domain carte.runesdechene.com (NXDOMAIN, removed from Netlify domain_aliases) -> dead links from shares and from Google results.
fix: User reinstalled the app. cert on Netlify (reissued 2026-05-23 18:00 UTC, chain complete leaf+E8->ISRG Root X1, verify OK). Code purge carte.->app.: ShareButton.tsx + all seo-pages templates (page/header/gallery/footer/place-content/sitemap) + robots.txt + llms.txt; removed legacy carte. redirects from explore-web netlify.toml and the IS_LEGACY_ORIGIN kill-switch branch from sw.ts; updated root+app CLAUDE.md and BOOTSTRAP. PENDING (manual, Netlify UI, no code): provision/renew cert for hub.runesdechene.com; make Netlify the sole Let's Encrypt issuer for app./hub. (remove app/hub as o2switch cPanel subdomains + disable their AutoSSL; keep only the DNS CNAME -> *.netlify.app).
